rotatingRing.does: rings whose seed drifts by a delta that never divides the step (no blind spots)

evenFan.does: an even fan: it constrains, nothing on the aim line

oddFan.does: an odd fan: one shot on the aim line, it makes you move

aimedBurst.does: a stream down the aim line

offsetTwins.does: pairs aimed either side of you: slip between

stackFan.does: a fan at a stack of speeds: gaps that open further out

doubleHelix.does: arms that reverse their turn each half period

accelSpiral.does: a spiral winding faster, to a cap

rose.does: a flower: a ring whose speed follows a rose curve r = cos(k theta)

gapWall.does: a wall across the plane with a gap that snakes row by row (at least three ship widths)

sineCurtain.does: a curtain of shots weaving in antiphase: lanes that sway

decelBurst.does: shells that slow to a stop, then burst into rings (BulletML)

accelRain.does: shots falling and gathering speed, placed on a jittered grid (no clumps, no holes)

curving.does: shots that arc round you after a straight start

splitShell.does: a heavy shell that splits into a fan of children

fragmentRing.does: a ring whose every shot splits once (capped: a ring of 8 into 24)

crossGate.does: two streams from either side whose lines cross at you

stratRain.does: a scatter on a jittered grid: random to the eye, fair to the hand

sweepBeam.does: a beam that warns, then burns, sweeping slower than the ship can run

snakeLaser.does: a laser that follows a weaving head (a ribbon over its trail)

homingSalvo.does: missiles that home, turning no faster than a cap, for a lifetime, then fly dumb

itano.does: the Itano circus: a fanned launch, an overshoot, three behaviours (straight, leading, weaving) homing at once

cageRing.does: a ring thrown out round you from its thrower, then closing in with one sector open (the bait ball as a pattern)

frenzyDash.does: glints peel off one by one, glint a warning, then dash straight at where you are

mixed.does: any pattern with a share of its shots outlined (only the roll answers them)
